text: Saltcombe Rovers started off strong and quickly took a 2-0 lead, thanks to a penalty from Leon Quinlan, significantly increasing their chances of winning to 97% [F68]. However, the game took an unexpected turn when Theo Ibarra scored for Duskvale Wanderers at the 45-minute mark, bringing the teams back to parity [F72]. Despite the early lead, Saltcombe Rovers failed to capitalize on their chances, creating just three big chances [F13] compared to Duskvale Wanderers' zero [F37]. Duskvale Wanderers showcased great resilience, scoring the equalizer at 2-2 and eventually pulling ahead with Yusuf Osei's goal in the 90th minute, securing a dramatic 3-2 win [F84]. This comeback story highlighted their determination and fighting spirit, despite trailing in the first half.
